The fuzzer calls `pj_transform(pj_src, pj_dst, 1, 0, &x, &y, NULL)` with `point_count=1`. So the `point_count == 1` guard in `pj_fwd`/`pj_inv` paths short-circuits the `transient_error` access.

But the `CHECK_RETURN` macro in `pj_datum_transform` does NOT have the `point_count == 1` guard. So if `last_errno` is set to a value <= -50 during `pj_datum_transform`, we get OOB.

The question remains: can `last_errno` be set to <= -50 during `pj_datum_transform`? The functions called there set errors -45 (geocentric), -38 (gridshift). None set <= -50.

If `pj_Set_Geocentric_Parameters` fails, it returns -45 but doesn't set `last_errno`. So `CHECK_RETURN` checks `last_errno` which is 0, so it doesn't trigger.
